title: terrace.yaml, Helm layer version 1
description: A repository's settings for terrace-contract, at the root of the Git repository. Normative prose is in REPO.md. Sections are open: a key this version does not define is not refused here, because an older terrace-contract must be able to read a file written for a newer one. The CLI reports such keys instead, and fails on them under --strict.

version.description: The layer version this file is written against. Read before anything else; a CLI that does not support it refuses the file.

cli.description: The terrace-contract release this repository is checked with, as MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Read by the setup action and by `terrace-contract doctor`.

^x-.description: Reserved for extensions. Never read and never reported by terrace-contract.

charts.description: The chart tree, relative to the directory holding this file. Default `charts`.

firstParty.description: Image repositories this organisation builds, and so the ones expected to publish a contract. A trailing `*` matches any suffix; anything else is an exact repository, matched against `image.repository` as written in a chart's values.

signer.description: The certificate identity, as a regular expression, every image's signature must carry before its contract is fetched. Organisation-specific; there is no default.
